dataset.title: Images
dataset.template: One row per picture: text, mean word confidence, lines, the box of every word, the real format and size, and a status with a plain reason for anything that was not read. Fields: url, input, inputIndex, status, reason, billable, imageFormat, imageWidth, imageHeight, inputWidth, inputHeight, rotated, scaled, language, chars, lines, confidence, text, words.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.template: Counters of the run under RUN_SUMMARY-<runId> in the image-ocr-api-summary store: requested, imagesAttempted, imagesProcessed, imagesNotChecked, linesThatAreNotImages, deliveredImages (every picture row that reached the buyer), chargedImages (rows that took money), deliveredUncharged, deliveredUnconfirmed, chargedEvents, billingActive, stopReason, byStatus.
